status: Partial human reconstruction of RH and unrestricted Dirichlet GRH, accepting the pinned formal proof as correct. Version 0.57 continues the detailed proof-note approach with 101 independently reviewed numbered claims, bringing the inventory to 3746. It completes the original rank-two component theorem, the universal conditional period Gram expansion, the determinant-jet window and its actual integral row realization, the full section-growth input through explicit classical abelian-variety theorems, and the original faithful-invariant/fixed-basis/nonlinear-decompletion/etale-functor construction. No additional whole selected obligation is closed: 24 remain, comprising 17 class C and 7 class B, with 17 shared RH/GRH and 7 additional unrestricted Dirichlet-GRH obligations. The exact original retained producer hypotheses remain explicit. GLOBAL_LOCAL_GAIN remains fully closed from v0.49. Counts are inventories, not completion percentages. No Lean replay or PDF is claimed.
local_conclusions: ACC1–ACC27 supply the complete rank-two component-propagation theorem. Grothendieck connectedness gives finite component chains from the exact APD variable/relation excess. A finite-character detector and the actual strict triangular fibre give the dimension bounds, and elementary prime avoidance constructs the Nice curves. Homogeneous incidence and a Laurent-coordinate seed construction preserve the original weaker seed inclusion and choose one closed point before every local object. The final theorem retains exactly FinLam, P1-prime and SeedIn. The general c1ch and several dimension/incidence suppliers also hold at rank three; its parity, exceptional-chain and automorphic producers remain separate.

PGR proves the literal universal KExpansionC under its original folding, square-integrability, orbital-integrability, choice-independence and convergence premises. The scalar absolute majorant is established before unfolding. Support cells, rational returns, integral Levi splitting and finite phases identify the actual Poincare periods with the prescribed orbital operator sum. The exact antilinear column convention and original normalizing scalar are preserved. The period/Gram identity supplies no new family existence or uniform spectral bound.

DJW1–DJW21 prove the full determinant-jet short window with an explicit factorial and Newton-coefficient argument. An integer interpolation matrix forces one sufficiently small valuation in every translated interval. The full arbitrary-index BiValue identity and original factorial loss then supply BiContent/BiWindow. Integral completion of split rows, standard Cartier coordinates and ordinary differential substitution construct the actual integral germs, with unit determinant factor, on the same supplied normal form. All four MtoHM fields and the full every-h1 block_of_normal_form statement are proved. RowData.LemmaM existence remains the precise upstream producer.

SGV supplies the full original section-finiteness-and-growth input. The literal identity-base product is identified with the original abelian variety, preserving the section coordinates, coefficient action and dimension g. PBC26 supplies one very ample power N. The explicit classical index theorem and abelian Riemann–Roch give dim SecM(N*t)=d*t^g for every positive integer t, with d=dim SecM(N)>=1; PBC27 supplies all integer-power finiteness. This removes GSL_FINITE_GROWTH in every characteristic, while the other multiplication, descent, rank and square inputs remain.

FET1–FET26 supply the full original FaithH, fixed basis, nonlinear matrix decompletion, EtBasis and WEt. Sharp coordinates recover the cyclotomic field from its tilt. A generic determinant average and trace-one corrections produce a genuinely fixed integral basis. A parameter contraction followed by p-adic matrix corrections constructs the Frobenius change of basis, after which linear Frobenius descent places the Galois action and every lattice morphism over the actual coefficient ring. WPR30 supplies the corresponding Wach lattice under the original BS and LocTied premises. Herr, quantitative comparison and common ConclF remain explicit.
remaining_major_inputs: PGR proves the full original KExpansionC at its literal universal analytic premises: FoldOK and InHH for both words, FundExists, OOIntAll, OOFundIndep, AmpWellDef and AbsConvT. The support-cell and rational-return dictionaries, finite phase, integral Levi splitting, absolute majorant before unfolding and the actual orbital operator sum preserve the original measures, representative systems, character and column normalization. The resulting period/Gram and operator-compression conclusions retain their printed original inputs; existence of an automorphic family and uniform spectral estimates are not supplied by that identity. The next bounded analytic producer is full InHHC: identify the actual scalar convolution representatives with the original Hilbert-space operators and prove the final automorphic-range equation, reusing PGR's convergence, L2 and reproduction results. The KExpTied join must then receive FoldOKC, InHHC, FundExistsC, OOIntAllC, OOFundIndepC, AmpWellDefC and AbsConvC on the same setting and both words. AbsConv retains operator-norm and auxiliary-vector summability and positive Gam1; scalar integrated convergence alone is insufficient. RCV already supplies full CovolRef for independent words and every original domain. The independent measure tasks are broad JacGauge and the original PlaceSplit/ProdExact consumers, producing RealBracket on those same measures. SVW conditional VolStabFromSWS and actual InVolumes remain complete at their original SWa1 and StabilizerFirstChernCompatibility premises; those premises, finite-place factors and other mass/index/column/form/counting fields remain. BQS full BesselNVGap is available. Forms0, all-family Witt/genus/level/intertwiner Transport/LevelMatch, Bessel uniqueness, AutTie/RowDictTie/LabTie, simultaneous arithmetic cylinder counts and normalized GLOBAL_SPECTRAL remain.

PBC supplies full arbitrary-base polarized pullback, actual very-ampleness and every-integer-power SecM finiteness. SGV now supplies the full original secM_finite_and_growth, hence GSL_FINITE_GROWTH: on the literal identity-base product there are fixed integers N>=1 and d>=1 with dim SecM(N*t)=d*t^g for every t>=1. Its explicit classical inputs are Milne Proposition 9.1 and Theorem 13.3(b),(c); the section-coordinate and scalar dictionaries, ampleness and geometric-integrality/dimension hypotheses are proved on the original object in every characteristic. DJW supplies full ThmP, arbitrary-index BiValue, BiContent/BiWindow, all four MtoHM fields and full block_of_normal_form for every supplied restriction identity. It constructs actual integral germs with the exact unit determinant factor, and obtains the original row window from the original MConcl. The original RowData.LemmaM existence producer remains: adapted Cartier chains, residue ranks, pairing-kernel estimate and weighted remainder must construct that normal form on the given row data. Remaining for the geometric section laws are multiplication-pullback generated comparison, finite/flat/surjective and etale multiplication geometry, invariant-function descent on every relevant open, the later every-positive-power GSL_VANISH_CLOSED conclusion, the required arbitrary-test integrality, principal rank one, torsion-indexed section decomposition, and square/translation generators. SHV17 all-cover eventual Serre vanishing and SHV21 homogeneous-polynomial generation remain complete. The completed identity-base integrality and growth do not themselves supply these different contracts. Original Moduli and HUF/PUN foundations remain. Later finite-level systems, Gaussian/reproduction, simultaneous dictionaries, ramified jets, all-tuple class sums, phase-sensitive uniqueness, common PointIdentCore and base ClassSumsSpan remain, retaining both levels, whole fields, Fits and eta agreement.

ACC proves full original c1ch from complete-local connectedness and transports the exact APD presentation to component chains at both ranks. It supplies full loc_dim, fibre, ab_gen, l52, NicePrimeEx, min_hom, jac and l41. The original rank-two sharp2 and PropagationTheoremGL2 are now complete at their literal FinLam, P1-prime and SeedIn premises. The rank-two triangular bound, strict bad-locus bounds, Nice-curve application and seedpt are proved as rank-two specializations; the weaker seed inclusion is preserved, and one closed point is chosen before every original local coefficient extension. The original automorphic P1-prime and seed producers remain hypotheses, not consequences of connectedness. Next are rank three's separate EPres parity data and Sharp theorem, the remaining triangular bound, the rank-two-to-three corner and seed incidence, the exceptional/thick chain installation, rank-three propagation and OffFin. Ordinary APD pres and the now-complete rank-two theorem do not replace these extra rank-three contracts. Existence of originally supplied universal spaces, actual automorphic ModIn/ModU, patching/modularity, classicality, arithmetic P and stronger Alt WitA/WitAQ outputs remain separate. Keep the common marked frame, rank-specific rings/ideals, all coefficient maps and both actual O-prime extensions. Host ell=3 remains included. No upstream FinA conclusion is used.

FET now proves the full original FaithH, actual cyclotomic-kernel fixed basis, nonlinear EtalePhiMatrixDecompletionToWach conjugacy, EtBasis and WEt on the original period rings for every original prime and lattice. Perfectoid cyclotomic fixed-field recovery is proved through sharp coordinates, with the finite-extension theorem explicitly retained as a classical foundation. Finite trace-one averaging and adic lifting construct an integral fixed basis without division by the finite quotient order. The nonlinear conjugacy is distinct from the earlier linear solution descent IFD25: a parameter contraction first gives a basis modulo p, and IFD24 supplies each subsequent p-adic matrix correction. FET descends the actual Galois action and every lattice morphism, preserving all WEt fields and scalar towers. WPR30 therefore gives WachEx for this actual functor on each supplied good layer under its original BS and LocTied/IsStd premises. The actual ExistsLocalWachFunctor assembly still needs the group, series and inclusion records from NormCoeAlgebraMap.lean, OneAddXMulDerivativeBinomial.lean and TeichPow.lean; the downstream WIS/WPR/FET statements retain these records as supplied data. Reuse their completed generic maps while assembling these original records. Then prove the Herr class maps in ExistsUniqueFits.lean and the comparison producer in ChiGamPowNeOne.lean. Preserve torsion, full inverse-image finite local conditions, coefficient-normalized lengths and both orders of the signed clusters. Full HW/Fon/Cmp is not yet claimed. Every original local row/table estimate must then hold in one common ConclF family, retaining ShaFinOdd, exceptional sets, vvTerm summability and uniform thresholds. There is no additional outer-layer transition-system hypothesis. SSC, DFD12 and DNE remain available, with DNE K=2000(|Ca|+1)^3 fixed before the family. Whole GLOBAL_DENOMINATOR remains open.

Complete the original F3 local coefficient bridges and F4 common-overfield readings, with valuation/norm/GoodCoef/iq and the entire coefficient field, and actual complex Hecke standard/no-Jordan plus arithmetic character data on the same form datum. Construct the actual base rows, host/frame lengths, nonzero chains and group ties, MultEq support, eigensystem/carrier/parts, all-embedding logLam, HD/d3b and NEb. Keep the stronger second DivRows3 scope distinct from the completed first DivDef3 and row-pair integrability. The full arithmetic entry and conditional common-frame construction do not by themselves install HOST_NUMBER_S, HOST_FRAME_LENGTH, TASK_HOST_VAN_E_INSTALL, TASK_HOST_XPP_INSTALL or TASK_COUNT_V_INSTALL.

Common design existence, NBUILT compatibility, original true-column records, shared fields/embeddings, Fits and eta agreement, simultaneous rows and eventual-family thresholds remain explicit.
